description: This PHP class, CompilerRuntime, is part of the JMESPath library and handles compiling JMESPath expressions into executable PHP code, managing cache files, and executing expressions on provided data.

classes.name: CompilerRuntime
classes.description: Handles compilation of JMESPath expressions into PHP code, caching, and execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CompilerRuntime with optional cache directory and parser, ensuring cache directory exists or throwing an exception.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes a JMESPath expression against provided data, compiling it into PHP code if necessary.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a JMESPath expression into PHP code and writes it into a cache file.
